problems: The fender plates point the wrong way. Each plate's position uses y - r·sin(a) but its tilt is -a, so the plates sit at odd angles instead of forming an arc over the wheel. That is why the eight loose boxes float in the air.
The plates are too short for their spacing, so even if the angles were right the arc would have gaps.
Nothing connects the fenders to the chassis; they need a bracket.

The moon dust (#cfd0d4) renders almost pure white in the foreground, so the white rover body and fenders blend into the ground and the chassis outline is lost. The dust needs to be a slightly deeper pale grey so the white body stands out. The crater rim is darkened to match.

Everything else checks out: there are four wheels on stub axles, each fender is held by a bracket, the two seats sit on pedestals, the mast is clamped to the front panel with the dish on a joint at its top, the orange tool box rests on the rear deck, and the framing holds the rover's main body.
